privacy.seoDescription: Privacy policy for VAN SHARE website and customer communications.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how VAN SHARE processes personal data in connection with B2B sales, contact requests, and website use in the EU.

dataController.address: ul. Batalionów Chłopskich 3, 58-050 Jelenia Góra, Poland

privacy.dataCollectedText: Contact and business data provided in forms or correspondence, including name, business email, phone number, city, order data, and communication content.
privacy.legalBasisText: We process data to respond to inquiries, perform contracts, issue invoices, and comply with legal obligations. Legal bases include GDPR Art. 6(1)(b), 6(1)(c), and 6(1)(f).
privacy.dataSharingText: We do not sell personal data. Data can be shared with payment, accounting, logistics, hosting, and email service providers strictly for service delivery and legal compliance.
privacy.retentionText: We keep personal data for as long as needed to provide services, handle claims, and fulfill accounting/tax obligations.
privacy.rightsText: You can request access, rectification, deletion, restriction, objection, and data portability where applicable. You may also lodge a complaint with a competent EU supervisory authority.

terms.seoDescription: Terms of service for orders, delivery, and website usage at VAN SHARE.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply to business customers (B2B) and govern sale, delivery, and communication related to charcoal products.
terms.scopeText: Website content is informational. Orders become binding only after explicit confirmation by VAN SHARE.
terms.ordersAndPricingText: Prices, availability, and lead times may change. Final commercial conditions are defined in the confirmed offer/order document.
terms.deliveryAndIncotermsText: Unless agreed otherwise, delivery terms are based on Incoterms 2020 (e.g., DAP Polkowice). Risk transfer and responsibilities follow the agreed Incoterm.
terms.paymentTermsText: Payment schedules and methods are specified in the confirmed commercial offer and invoice.
terms.liabilityText: VAN SHARE is not liable for delays or failures caused by force majeure, carrier disruptions, authority restrictions, or incorrect buyer-provided data.
terms.b2bStatusText: Consumer withdrawal rights do not apply to contracts concluded exclusively between businesses.
terms.governingLawText: These terms are governed by Polish law. Competent courts in Poland shall have jurisdiction unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

cookies.intro: This website uses cookies and similar technologies to ensure proper operation and maintain user preferences.
cookies.essentialText: Required for core site functionality such as language settings and secure communication. These cookies are always active.
cookies.optionalText: Optional analytics/marketing cookies are used only if implemented and only after valid user consent where required.
cookies.managingText: You can disable or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.
cookies.withdrawalText: If optional cookies are enabled in the future, users will be able to update or withdraw consent through cookie settings.
